node.title: Re: inconsistent eval timeout (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I'm not sure what's going wrong, but personally I'm not all too surprised there's an issue with signals and [doc://alarm] on Windows.

You might want to use a module such as [mod://IPC::Run], as it specifically supports timing out the processes it runs (I think this should work on Windows too). There are examples in its documentation and I showed an example here: [id://1219060].

Update: Sorry, I should have tested first. Doesn't seem to work on Windows 7, in my test the process just ran however long it wanted and didn't get interrupted by [mod://IPC::Run]'s timeout.
